about_the_game:
Bring an adorable little puppy onto your desktop!

My Desktop Puppy is a light-hearted virtual pet game that blends companionship, interaction, and relaxing desktop fun — so your screen will never feel lonely again.

You can drag your puppy around the desktop, pet it, play with it, feed it dog food, and watch it roll, nap, or act spoiled. You can toss toys and snacks, try different harnesses, and even take your puppy to various places for a walk. As you spend more time together, you’ll unlock beautiful illustrations and wallpapers that record your shared memories — like a little album that grows with your bond.

Features:

  • 🌟 True desktop-pet experience: Your puppy walks, naps, and interacts directly on your desktop without taking over your main window

  • ✋ Petting interaction: Tap or touch the puppy and enjoy its cute reactions

  • 🎮 Easy and relaxing controls: Click, drag, throw, and feed with simple gestures

  • 🍖 Drag-to-feed system: Drag dog food from your bag and your puppy will run over to eat

  • 🧸 Lots of interactive items: Balls, toys, snacks, bowls, harnesses, and more

  • 🚶 Take your puppy for a walk: Visit different scenes and collect new memories

  • 🎨 Rich animations: Sit, roll, blink, sleep, cuddle, and more adorable actions

  • 🖼️ Memory album system: Increase affection to unlock illustrations and wallpapers from your adventures together

  • 👀 Desktop pass-through: Never blocks your work or windows

  • 🖥️ Pixel art + 2.5D style: Warm and cozy visuals that blend naturally into your desktop

A tiny companion to bring warmth to your busy or quiet computer time — we hope you’ll love your little desktop puppy.

(Development is ongoing! We plan to add more actions, skins, scenes, and customization. Add to your wishlist and share your feedback!)

short_description: A desktop puppy who quietly keeps you company . It stays calm while you work and comes to play when you relax. Take walks, give toys and cute harnesses , and enjoy its happy reactions. With pass-through and draggable UI, it never gets in your way. Build affection to unlock lovely art and wallpapers
